info.title: OvenLovin API
info.description: The family recipe box your AI can actually use, and it knows who can't eat what. REST for agents. Not medical advice - always check labels.

apiKey.name: Authorization
apiKey.description: Household API key. Send `ApiKey rkapi_…` or `Bearer rkapi_…`. Create a key under Settings (full access if you omit scopes). A request outside the key's scopes returns 403 with type `<origin>/problems/forbidden`. Bound to one kitchen; a mismatched `X-Kitchen-Id` is rejected.

bearerAuth.description: Same API key as `rkapi_…` (ChatGPT Actions often send Bearer) or a Clerk session JWT. On MCP with a Clerk JWT, optional `X-Kitchen-Id` selects a kitchen you belong to. An API key is bound to one kitchen; a mismatched `X-Kitchen-Id` is rejected.

commitSha.description: VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA for this deploy, or null when not on Vercel.

displayServings.description: Kitchen Default servings, or the `servings` query override. `servings` remains the stored card yield.

previousEntries.description: Nights this PATCH changed, as they were before the edit. Use to revert.

includeStaples.description: Canonical flag for kitchen staples such as salt, pepper, and oil.

displayUnit.description: Unit inflected for the display quantity (`cloves` when the amount is 2).

isStaple.description: Canonical kitchen-staple flag (salt, oil, pepper). Distinct from the pantry food-taxonomy category.

post.summary: Import a recipe from a URL or pasted text
post.description: Preview by default (`save` omitted or false). Persist only when `save=true`. Preview responses include `saved:false` and `preview:true`. Send the previewed `draft` with `save=true` to persist without extracting again. Send `Idempotency-Key` so a dropped connection can be retried without a second recipe. URL duplicates and in-flight locks return 409 with `recipeId` / `recipeUrl`. Demo responses include `remainingImports`.

draft.description: Previewed recipe from a prior save:false call. Skips extract.

save.description: When true, persist the recipe. Default is preview only.

200.description: Extracted draft for review (save omitted or false), or an idempotent replay

post.summary: Extract a recipe from one or more photos (review by default). Persist only when save=true, same as POST /recipes/import. Exact SHA matches return 409 with the existing recipeId. Near-duplicate PNG photos (perceptual hash of PNG bytes only) are a warning: preview includes possibleDuplicate {recipeId,title}; save:true without allowDuplicate:true returns 409 with the same field. Send allowDuplicate:true to persist anyway. Send Idempotency-Key on save so retries do not create a second recipe.

draft.description: Previewed recipe from a prior save:false call. Skips extract.

allowDuplicate.description: When true, persist even if a similar PNG photo already exists.

patch.description: `entries` default to **merge** by date+meal: send one night to set, swap, or `{ clear: true }` to remove it. Other nights are left alone. Pass `entriesMode: replace` to rewrite the whole week. The response includes `previousEntries` for the nights this request changed.

entriesMode.description: How `entries` are applied. Default `merge` upserts by date+meal (use clear:true to remove a night). `replace` rewrites the whole week.
